invariants.rule: One row with a point owns one symbol; no clustering or aggregation, including quiet context dots
Membership is the district matched at build time from the row’s own data (row.admin, row.how); never re-assign by point-in-polygon on display coordinates or by a name at runtime
The default unit is listed rows (สาขา); other statuses are รายการ and never added to it
Counts only: no per-area or per-person density, no market share, size, members, sales or footfall wording
Missing is never zero: rows without a district are counted apart and named; a district without rows is measured_zero of this dataset
The Aha never cuts through a tie; all-equal districts read as spread
Numerator and denominator of every share are on screen; the studio comparison states both bases
Brands, companies and venues join by the sheet’s ids only; names are search keys
Company names are source-stated, not registry-certified; a missing record never reads as independent
Points are never invented or moved; display slots for co-located pins keep a leader to the anchor
Format colour always travels with its series shape cue; no star
Analytical colours are the LDS count LUT — all 41 samples by rank — identical on both themes; EVID-05 treatments use the dataState tokens
Every panel view ends with exactly one provenance line (dataset · source · date · boundary + unit clause)
Focus + quiet: detail only for the focused part; the automatic focus releases off screen, a user focus or selection never does
Outlines load per province on demand; panels, charts and table work without them
“จุดตกในอาคาร”, never “ตั้งอยู่ใน”; the building join never changes a count
Breadcrumb uses production codes and /D/ deep links; a branch is the heading, never a crumb
No addresses, phone numbers, map links, researcher notes or README text in the published data; https public links only
One release cache tag on every entry and module; versions agree across package.json, design-intent.json and the handoff JSON
Every 3D preset keeps pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3
The building being looked at (venue, building, branch with a point) is shown in the eye preset corner-on and fitted to the free part of the map on every way in; never refit after a user camera move
No other building hides the building being looked at: x-ray over buildings and road names, see-through front buildings, district labels off it
One list per building: venue-linked rows + rows whose own points fall in it, each once; it never changes an area count, membership or venue link
Colour scales always use all 41 LDS samples by rank (owner standing rule); never a 3/5-class pick
MapLibre stays pinned at 5.6.2 with the tile-cover guard (js/maplibre-guard.js); re-check the bug and the guard before any upgrade
Brand first: wherever a branch is named, the brand logo (when present) and the brand name come before the branch; a logo never replaces the name

Logos are the original bytes or a recorded derivative (uniform downscale, transparent-margin trim, SVG namespace) with the SHA-256 of both; no recolouring or tracing; chips are theme-invariant; a missing logo only means no logo

Outbound actions use public names and published points only, https, a new tab with noopener; they say once that the answers are Google’s; Street View only with a point, “ใกล้อาคาร” for a registry reference point
Icon fonts are addressed by content (?v= first 8 hex of the SHA-256) in the stylesheets, so a release never reuses another release’s font binary

An owner map audit in the research sheet (02_STORES map_audit_status owner_confirmed_located_in_host_YYYYMMDD) draws the branch at its accepted venue’s registry reference point; the published source point stays in the sheet and in the 00_README source-point count, is not drawn, and the folded facts say who confirmed it and when (meta.ownerConfirmedHost). Any other audit value stops the build.

A venue is addressed by its CityMETER UUID or its registry id (?venue=); the venue panel links to the same venue in CityMETER Shopping centers by registry id (https://montri-th.github.io/shoppingcenter/?venue=<registry id>)
